title: GET /api/projects/:id/journal — list journal entries
description: Return all non-deleted journal entries for a project, paginated and ordered newest-first.
acceptanceCriteria: GET requires auth and project ownership
Returns entries ordered by created_at DESC

steps.details: Parse query: page = parseInt(req.query.page) || 1, limit = Math.min(parseInt(req.query.limit) || 20, 100). offset = (page-1)*limit. Query: SELECT from journal_entries WHERE project_id = id AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT limit OFFSET offset. Also query total count. Return { entries, total, page, limit }.
Create 25 entries, GET page 1 (20) — verify 20 returned, total=25. GET page 2 — verify 5 returned.
